title: TAE Technologies–Trump Media merger announced two days after Loureiro's death

tellings.quote: The deal was announced on December 18th, 2025. Lorero died on December 16th.

plain: A merger between TAE Technologies, a company working on fusion energy, and Trump Media, the media company tied to President Donald Trump, was announced on December 18, 2025, just two days after the death of a scientist named Loureiro on December 16, Michels points out. He tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about top American scientists going missing. He raises the timing as a coincidence worth noticing, hinting the two events may be linked.
